name: Resampler Microphone
description: The `resampler` microphone platform converts the sample rate of the audio from another [microphone component](https://esphome.io/components/microphone/). Components that need a specific sample rate, such as a voice assistant expecting 16 kHz audio, can then use a microphone that only supports higher sample rates.

config_entries.label: Microphone
config_entries.description: The source microphone to resample. Supports `16` to `32` bits per sample and `1` or `2` channels.

config_entries.label: Bits Per Sample
config_entries.description: The bits per sample to use as input to the component. May be restricted by the component to a specific value.

config_entries.label: Filters
config_entries.description: The number of windowed sinc interpolation filters to use. Must be between `2` and `1024`. Defaults to `16`.

config_entries.label: Sample Rate
config_entries.description: Sample rate to convert to. Must be between `8000` and `48000`. Defaults to `16000`.

config_entries.label: Taps
config_entries.description: The number of taps per windowed sinc interpolation filter. Must be between `16` and `128` and divisible by 4. Defaults to `16`.
